: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) holds INR 553bn in FCNR(B) deposits (10% of Q1FY27 deposits). Management plans to deploy remaining FCNR liquidity into customer assets to support lending growth.
: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) Q2 2026: GNPA 1.04% vs 1.39% year‑ago, slippages Rs 1,230 crore, CAR 21.9%, CET1 21.4%. Brokers set price targets Rs 500–550, Buy ratings.
: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) reported a standalone loan book of Rs 5.5 trillion. Excludes loans from newly acquired Kotak Mahindra Investments portfolio and certain FCNR(B) deposits.

: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) saw 25% YoY growth in corporate advances in the September quarter, driven by higher working‑capital needs from rising oil‑linked input costs and longer shipping times.
